ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 8:1 ratio of low-intensity (black) pixels to high-intensity (white/grey) pixels; black dominates the medial surface while white is localized at distal margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal-focused pigmentation; high-contrast white and grey mottling concentrated at the lateral tips and along the superior trailing edges of both lobes, tapering to solid black towards the peduncle and central fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse, wide U-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 135-145 degrees and minimal bounding-box depth relative to fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous micro-serrations along the entire trailing edge; the right lobe exhibits higher amplitude peaks (rougher topography) near the distal tip compared to the relatively smoother serrations on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concave curves along the superior trailing edges converging at the median notch, with convex outer lateral trajectories reaching the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity (white), textured, roughly circular clusters of pixels concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, indicating heavy barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle encrustations on both fluke tips; irregular pixel loss (notching) visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
